name: @longtermsupport/ts-qa-ci
description: Orchestrated QA/CI pipeline for TypeScript/React projects - the TS analogue of lts/php-qa-ci
_peerDependenciesPolicy: Floors are set to the CURRENT major generation as of the last version check (npm view <pkg> version), not an old baseline carried forward out of habit — ts-qa-ci should push consumers toward current stable tooling, not accommodate years-old installs. Re-run `npm view <pkg> version` for every peerDependency before each ts-qa-ci release and bump these floors to the then-current major; do not silently let them go stale. EXCEPTION: typescript is capped below its own latest major when the typescript-eslint ecosystem hasn't caught up yet (checked via `npm view @typescript-eslint/parser peerDependencies` — its typescript range is the real ceiling, not TypeScript's own release cadence). Found 2026-07-10: typescript 7.x shipped as stable but typescript-eslint 8.63.0 (latest, and its canary) still caps at `typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0` — using 7.x would break type-aware linting for every consumer running typescript-eslint. Floor set to the newest version actually inside that ceiling (6.0.3), not 5.x (stale) or 7.x (unsupported).
